entries.description: BeatByte is a free, open-source (MIT) five-lane rhythm game for macOS, Windows and Linux, written in Rust. It turns the player's own music files into playable charts in four difficulties, shows karaoke lyrics, runs on a 3D concert stage, and plays with a keyboard, gamepads or a guitar controller, for one to four local players. No song ships with the game; nothing is uploaded.
